text_simplified: A parent should seek lawful provision for its great blessing and hold regular faith-centered gatherings at home where children read from Quranic exegesis, hadith, and the Prophetic biography, instilling the examples of the Mothers of the Believers and righteous female Companions in the daughter's heart, and both parents must model upright behavior by guarding prayer and avoiding music, backbiting, gossip, and lying; for the righteousness of parents preserves their children during their lives and after their death.

source_meta.source_title: Lamahat fi Tarbiyat al-Banat (Glimpses into Raising Daughters)

review_defects.why: The Arabic is singular «الجلسة» (the sitting/gathering) and does not contain "Family"; the English pluralizes and adds "Family".
"regular" is added; the Arabic says «الحرص على عقد جلسة» (be keen on holding a sitting) without any frequency qualifier.
